name: UPGRADE!!!
blurb: Active:  Heimerdinger can empower his next ability to apply an additional effect. These empowered abilities have the same cooldowns as their basic forms, deal modified damage, and do not cost mana.

effects.description: Toggle: Heimerdinger empowers his next basic ability for an additional effect, consuming the empowerment upon cast and placing UPGRADE!!! on full cooldown. These empowered abilities have the same cooldowns as their basic forms, deal modified damage, and do not have a mana cost.
UPGRADE!!! incurs its static cooldown on-cast, and can be toggled off to remove the empowerment and place the ability on its static cooldown.
UPGRADE!!! can be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.

notes:
Toggled abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as  Spellblade and triggering  Force Pulse's passive.
Consuming the buff for an empowered basic ability does.
No compensations for  mana are made if UPGRADE!!! is toggled off; Heimerdinger will lose 100 mana each time he toggles the ability on and off.
